svg.title: How a tap finds its Autodarts tab
svg.desc: A tap on a player goes to the Autodarts tab shown in the window used last, then to a tab shown in another window, then to the tab shown most recently. A tab that doesn't answer, as one that was open before an update of the extension, first gets the content script of this version and the request once more, without a reload. When no tab answers even then, the extension reloads the tab in front, or opens Autodarts behind the popup when no tab is open, and waits until the page has renewed the session it started with. Then it switches there, and every other Autodarts tab reloads with the new player.
